title: Preparing the Community Hall for the Winter Fair

headings.text: Preparing the Community Hall for the Winter Fair

key_sentences: The fair opens on the first Saturday of December.
Volunteers should arrive one hour before the doors open.
The caretaker will unlock the side entrance at eight o'clock.
Thank you for helping to make the fair a success.
Please report any damage to the coordinator before you go home.

list_items.text: Extension cables and a power strip
A cash box with small change
→ Switch off the heating in the main hall
→ Stack the chairs along the north wall
→ Return the keys to the office of the caretaker
→ Sign the volunteer sheet at the entrance
